reviews.review: I like the look: glowing ghost, a new colour for each stage, hazards easy to see. But I got stuck too much. In First Steps my run stood in front of two spike clusters for 45 seconds, and in Spike Garden even the expert found no way forward. That is not fun in a five-minute break. Saw Mill kills beginners at 11% and Laser Gate killed me after two seconds, before I understood the blink timing. Crumble Bridge felt right, tense but fair. Spring Loaded is pretty but nobody died, so it has no thrill. Gauntlet is a wall of red at the laser and spikes.
reviews.best: Crumble Bridge is clear, tense and fair, and most players finish it.
reviews.worst: Spike Garden leaves even the high-skill player stuck with no way forward.

reviews.review: The curve is broken. Spike Garden is stage 2 but only 30% pass it, and even the high-skill run stalls below a spiked ledge with no readable route. Saw Mill at 27% is harder than Crumble Bridge at 77%, and Spring Loaded has zero deaths, so springs are never tested. Laser Gate kills two of three players at the first beam after two seconds; I see no safe place to learn the blink timing. First Steps and Crumble Bridge teach well. Gauntlet combines every mechanic, which I like, but 23% with one death cluster before the goal feels punishing. Screens are clear and hazards read well.
reviews.best: Crumble Bridge introduces crumbling tiles on safe ground first and lands in the target band with readable deaths.
reviews.worst: Spike Garden is a stage-2 wall where even the high-skill player finds no way forward.

reviews.review: I like the bones: Ferry Lines, Crumble Bridge and Gauntlet give me real routing and timing, and the hazards read cleanly. But the curve is broken. Spike Garden is harder than the finale: my mid ghost stood at a ledge for 45 seconds and even the high-skill run gave up at 58%, so I cannot trust the stage. First Steps also stalls a player in front of a spike pair. Saw Mill at 27% is too sharp for stage 3. Spring Loaded is a free 9-second ride with zero deaths, no reason to optimise. Laser Gate kills at 18% in two seconds, which feels like a cycle lottery.
reviews.best: Gauntlet and Ferry Lines mix hazards into a route that rewards clean timing.
reviews.worst: Spike Garden stalls even the high-skill player at a ledge, so it looks unfinishable instead of hard.

git.subject: v4: bot script fix 2 (no stage change): view lag no longer moves the platform under the bot
git.body:
Measurement (v3): stage 4 mid-skill pass 22.0%, 305 pit deaths. Traces show
bots that ride a ferry and then step into the pit. Cause is in the bot
script: a bot plans with a late view of moving hazards (0-9 frames). The
same late time was used for the platform that carries the bot, so its plan
started from a wrong own position.
Change: plans use the real time for moving platforms; the late view stays
for saws and lasers. Test before commit on stage 4: mid 22.0% -> 45.3%.
Physics and stages are the same as v3. The bots differ from v3 in this
one point.

simDiff.del: // (bots plan with th = t - lag, the game always calls it with th = t).
simDiff.add: // (bots plan with th = t - lag for saws and lasers; platforms use t since v4. The game calls it with th = t).
